Lemon rice
Serves 2.
2 cups cooked rice, cooled
1 lemon, juiced
1 tablespoon oil
1 teaspoon mustard seeds
A pinch of turmeric, a few curry leaves, salt to taste
Heat the oil and add the mustard seeds. When they pop, add the curry leaves and turmeric.
Stir in the rice and salt, then the lemon juice. Serve warm.
